text:
sara: Quick heads-up — kicking off an ad-hoc least-privilege sweep for the Analytics service tonight (10:00pm PST). Goal: remove unused admin grants, confirm KMS key owners, and collect evidence for the access review. Anyone actively owning svc-analytics keys or cross-account grants? cc @mike @aya

mike: I’m the current owner for svc-analytics until EOD tomorrow. Can we limit the sweep to: 1) admin-roles, 2) cross-account KMS grants, 3) ownerless service keys? don’t want a full blast right now. :eyes:

aya: +1 to scoped run. I’ll kick off the entropy/owner scan first and post results. Running the scan against prod analytics set now — taking ~8m. Run command I’m using:```./scripts/priv-scan --env prod --service analytics --scope "admin,keys" --output /tmp/analytics-privscan.json```

access-bot: Scan job queued (id: scan-20260322-11). Estimated 8m. Results will be posted to this thread when ready.

nate: FYI infra: noticed gaps in KMS audit ingestion last week for a small key shard (k-analytics-0[3-5]). I opened infra ticket https://infra.internal/ISSUE-1234 — might miss some grant creation events in the logs. Don’t trust auto-revokes for those keys until we confirm logs.

aya: scan-20260322-11 finished. Summary: 7 ownerless grants, 3 cross-account grants, 12 admin role members with no recent activity. Posting filtered table (trimmed):
```
key             | grant_id     | grant_principal        | last_seen
k-analytics-03 | g-9321       | acct:partner-xyz       | 2025-11-02
k-analytics-07 | g-9900       | svc:legacy-ingest      | 2023-07-10
ownerless total: 7
```

sara: Thanks — Nate, can infra surface raw KMS events for k-analytics-03..05 to S3 for the next 30d so we can backfill evidence? If not possible, we’ll mark those keys as "manual-review" and exclude auto-prune.

nate: I can enable event-forwarding. Will need a short maintenance window (5m) to apply the forwarder. Scheduling now, ETA 23:15 PST. Will drop logs to s3://redwood-sec/kms-backfill/scan-20260322/ and post a manifest.

mike: Proposed action plan: 1) manual review for keys with missing logs (nate list), 2) automated revoke for ownerless grants that are older than 90d and not cross-account, 3) canary prune 11:00pm PST for 5 keys, evidence uploaded to security-svcowner@redwood.com. Are we all aligned?

sara: Aligned. Add a rollback/escrow step for any revoke: capture `aws kms list-grants --key-id ...` and `aws kms create-grant` output so we can recreate if needed. Example minimal rollback snippet:```bash
# capture grants before revoke
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/k-analytics-07 > /tmp/k7-grants.json
# revoke (example)
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/k-analytics-07 --grant-id g-9900
```

aya: I’ll run the canary prune at 23:00 PST against the 5 least-risky keys and post the evidence bundle (grant dumps + access history) to the thread. I’ll tag owners and write ticket for any unexpected fallout. :thumbsup:

access-bot: Canary prune scheduled by aya for 2026-03-22T23:00:00-08:00. Will post results to thread.

mike: Small ask: for cross-account grants, please confirm partner teams via the partner slack before revoke. Don’t want to break scheduled pipelines.

aya: will do — pinging partner-ops now.

partner-ops (external): saw aya's ping, we only use g-9321 for a read-only export job. We can switch to the new read-only key alias by Monday. No outage expected if rotation happens tonight after 23:30 PST.

sara: OK — mark g-9321 as delayed (rotate Monday). Proceed with the other 4. Remember to attach `evidence.json` to the access ticket and include the `pre-revoke-grants` file.

aya: Canary prune complete. Results: 4 grants revoked, 1 deferred (g-9321). Evidence uploaded: s3://redwood-sec/privs/evidence/2026-03-22/canary-1-manifest.json. No alerts fired. Posting quick diff: revoked-grants: [g-1001, g-1002, g-1011, g-1020].

mike: Nice — can you also paste the `pre-revoke-grants` file contents for g-1001 so we have inline evidence?

aya: pasted below:
```json
{"key":"k-analytics-11","grants":[{"grantId":"g-1001","principal":"svc:old-worker","operations":["Decrypt"]}],"captured_at":"2026-03-22T22:58:00Z"}
```

sara: Great work — next steps: 1) schedule full RBAC sampling next week, 2) create a short policy doc for owners to verify grants quarterly, 3) follow up on infra ticket ISSUE-1234 until KMS log gaps are resolved. I’ll open the org-level follow-up PR for the policy.

mike: I’ll take the quarterly verification doc. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

oncall-bot: Noting incident window: no user-facing incidents observed. If anyone sees anomalies, escalate via #incidents immediately.

sara: closing thread — will add action items to the security board. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
